_comment: Functions ported from Sam4.exe to the other builds by tools/sigscan.py (unique wildcarded signature). Source evidence in docs/re/R1_vtable.md.

engine_alloc._note: FUN(size, tag) allocator: 2nd direct call in viewport_render_vr

holder_create._note: render-target holder (re)create: (holder, gfx, w, h, fmt=2, 0, flags, 0); flag 4 = double width

holder_get._note: holder -> texture wrapper; device eye RT = *(wrapper+8)

set_playing_in_vr._note: native CPlayerSimulationData::SetPlayingInVR(psd, int): 12th direct call of bind_local_user_psd, the only native caller (passes 0) (R3 s1)

bind_local_user_psd._note: binds the local user to its psd; only native caller of set_playing_in_vr, passes 0 (R3 s1)

vrd_init._note: CPlayerVRData init (vrd, player); two unguarded device slot 0x208 calls (R3 s7)

vrd_controller_world._note: CPlayerVRData controller world placement (vrd, P7* out, role): 2nd direct call of the script wrapper (R3 s2)

client_action_vr._note: ClientActionVR net stub + apply; writes player+0x25c8 unguarded (R3 s4)

client_action._note: desktop ClientAction net stub + apply (player vt+0x1298) (R3 s4)

send_vr_action._note: native ClientActionVR sender (player), builds args from vrd (R3 s4)

aim_writer._note: player aim/target writer (R8 s4); its calls to the shared return-1 stub gate the barrel ray (R8 s8 A)

crosshair_render._note: CWeaponCrosshairHudElement vt+0x80 render (R8 s1; SM = slot 0x80 of vtable 0x1415e1c70)
